"SEC. 2466. Resular and actins judaes.£
municipal courts.-There shall be a municipal court
for the City of Manila, for which six judges shall
be appointed, to be known, respectively, as judge
of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, and
sixth branch. Whenever the public interest so
requires, the Secretary of Justice may designate
ary of the judges to hold session at night.
"The municipal court shall have the same juris-
diction in civil ard crimiral cases and the same
incidental powers as at present conferred by law
upor the nunicipal court and justice of the peace
court of the City of Manila, and such additional
jurisdiction and powers as may hereafter be con-
ferred upon them by law.
the cases pertaining to
the municipal court shall be distributed in accord-
arce with rules to be prescribed by the Secretary
MIn case of absence, sickness or incapacity of
any of the judges of the municipal court and in
case of any vacarcy in said offices, the Secretary
of Justice way designate any solicitor of the Bureau
of Justice or provincial fiscal to act as judge of
the muricipal court of the City of Manila, with all
the powers of a regular judge of said court; but
such acting judge shall not receive any additional
compensation during the time he is acting as judge."
2. That all Acts or parts of Acts which are incon-
sistent with the provisions of this executive order are
hereby repealed.
Done at the city of lantha this 7 day of June, in
the vear of Our Lord, nineteen hurdred and forty-five,
